problem.statement: Should Cobalt Ledger launch an AI package for its small-business customers in H1 2027, in what form and at what price, so that it pays back within 24 months?
problem.decision_maker: CEO, approving the launch budget and date
success_criteria: No rise in churn among the smallest customers

one_day_answer.situation: Small firms are adopting AI fast but have barely used it in accounting, and Cobalt Ledger has no AI package
one_day_answer.complication: Intuit, Xero and others already build AI into their plans, so AI is becoming standard and waiting risks losing customers
one_day_answer.resolution: Launch an AI package in H1 2027 built into bookkeeping and the month-end close, priced as a tier uplift that pays back within 24 months
